pages.title: Advanced Dominion Wand
pages.description: The Advanced  Dominion Wand is an  upgraded Dominion  Wand with the  ability to control  link order and link  multiple blocks at  once. Use the radial  menu to toggle  between First/Second  link order and  Single/Multi link  count. In Multi  mode, Shift +
Right-clicking a  block will find all  connected blocks of  the same type and  link them all at  once.
